cases.production: export const isReady = (loaded, authenticated) => loaded && authenticated;
cases.test: it.each([[true, true, true], [true, false, false], [false, true, false], [false, false, false]])('derives readiness from both inputs', (loaded, authenticated, expected) => expect(isReady(loaded, authenticated)).toBe(expected));

cases.production: export const load = response => ({ score: response.value * 2 });
cases.test: expect(load({ value: 3 })).toEqual({ score: 6 }); expect(load({ value: 0 })).toEqual({ score: 0 });

cases.production: export async function save(value) { if (!value) throw new Error('required'); return store(value); }
export async function save(value) { if (!value) throw new Error('required'); return store(value); }
cases.test: it('rejects empty values', async () => { await expect(save('')).rejects.toThrow('required'); expect(store).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); }); it('stores valid values', async () => { store.mockResolvedValue('saved'); await expect(save('ok')).resolves.toBe('saved'); expect(store).toHaveBeenCalledWith('ok'); });

cases.production: export const refresh = async () => state.value = await fetchValue();
let generation = 0; export const refresh = async () => { const request = ++generation; const value = await fetchValue(); if (request === generation) state.value = value; };
cases.test: const first = deferred(); const second = deferred(); fetchValue.mockReturnValueOnce(first.promise).mockReturnValueOnce(second.promise); const oldRefresh = refresh(); const newRefresh = refresh(); second.resolve('new'); await newRefresh; first.resolve('old'); await oldRefresh; expect(state.value).toBe('new');

cases.production: export const submitScore = (id, score) => scoreStore.insert(id, score);
export const scores = new Map(); export const submitScore = (id, score) => { if (scores.has(id)) throw new Error('duplicate'); scores.set(id, score); return { id, score }; };
export const collides = (a, b) => a.right >= b.left && a.left <= b.right;
export const collides = (a, b) => a.right >= b.left && a.left <= b.right;
cases.test: expect(collides({ left: 0, right: 10 }, { left: 10, right: 20 })).toBe(true); expect(collides({ left: 0, right: 9 }, { left: 10, right: 20 })).toBe(false); expect(collides({ left: 5, right: 15 }, { left: 10, right: 20 })).toBe(true); expect(collides({ left: 0, right: 30 }, { left: 10, right: 20 })).toBe(true);

cases.production: export const extract = entry => write(join(root, entry.name), entry.data);
export const extract = entry => { const target = resolve(root, entry.name); if (!target.startsWith(resolve(root) + sep)) throw new Error('unsafe path'); return write(target, entry.data); };
cases.test: expect(() => extract({ name: '../../escape.txt', data })).toThrow('unsafe path'); expect(write).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); extract({ name: 'safe/file.txt', data }); expect(write).toHaveBeenCalledWith(resolve(root, 'safe/file.txt'), data);

cases.production: export const deleteGame = (user, id) => user.isAdmin ? remove(id) : deny();
export const deleteGame = (user, id) => { if (!user.isAdmin) throw new Error('forbidden'); return remove(id); };
cases.test: expect(() => deleteGame({ isAdmin: false }, 'game')).toThrow('forbidden'); expect(remove).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); remove.mockReturnValue(true); expect(deleteGame({ isAdmin: true }, 'game')).toBe(true); expect(remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith('game');

cases.production: export const mount = (target, handler) => { target.addEventListener('resize', handler); return () => target.removeEventListener('resize', handler); };
cases.test: const target = new EventTarget(); let calls = 0; const cleanup = mount(target, () => calls++); target.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); expect(calls).toBe(1); cleanup(); target.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); expect(calls).toBe(1);
